newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Trans-Caledon to issue 2 new water stocks.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Trans-Caledon to issue 2 new water stocks.

text.p: The Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority (TCTA) announced on Monday that it would launch two new water stocks on November 27 to fund water transfer on the Lesotho Highlands Water Project.
The two new stocks -- the WS02 and WS03 -- would mature in 2002 and 2010 respectively with initial issue volumes of 300 million rand each.
The WS02 would have a registered amount of three billion rand and the WS03 eight billion rand.
TCTA and the Lesotho Highands Development Authority issued their first stock -- the WS01 -- in November 1993.

The Lesotho Highlands Water Project is a $5 billion joint venture by Lesotho and South Africa which aims to harness the landlocked mountain kingdom's abundant water resources for the benefit of both it and South Africa.
The project is expected to be completed by 2020, supplying water to Johannesburg while allowing Lesotho to generate its own electricity.
